name: PAT_EMAILS_TO_MEMBER
description: Emails sent to the member via Tapestry Auto Actions.

columns.name: PAT_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the patient record for this row. This column is frequently used to link to the PATIENT table.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: SENT_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The UTC date and time when an email was sent to the member by an automatic action.

columns.name: EMAIL_ADDRESS
columns.description: The email address to which the message was sent.

columns.name: NOTE_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the note record of the email sent to the member.

columns.name: EMAIL_SUBJECT_SMARTTEXT_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the SmartText record used as the subject line of the email sent to the member.

columns.name: EMAIL_SUBJECT_SMARTTEXT_ID_SMARTTEXT_NAME
columns.description: The name of the SmartText record.

columns.name: EMAIL_PLAIN_TEXT_SMARTTEXT_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the SmartText record used as the plain text template for the email sent to the member.

columns.name: EMAIL_PLAIN_TEXT_SMARTTEXT_ID_SMARTTEXT_NAME
columns.description: The name of the SmartText record.

columns.name: EMAIL_HTML_SMARTTEXT_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the SmartText record used as the HTML body for the email sent to the member.

columns.name: EMAIL_HTML_SMARTTEXT_ID_SMARTTEXT_NAME
columns.description: The name of the SmartText record.

columns.name: FROM_USER_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the user who sent the email to the member.

columns.name: FROM_USER_ID_NAME
columns.description: The name of the user record. This name may be hidden.
